actions.description: Create a contact under a lead.
actions.name: create-contact

lead_id.description: The ID of the lead to create the contact under. Example: lead_xxx

name.description: The full name of the contact.

title.description: The job title of the contact.

actions.description: Create a note activity on a lead.
actions.name: create-note-activity

value.description: Opportunity value in whole USD dollars. Example: 50000

value_period.description: Value period: one_time, monthly, or annual

user_id.description: User ID to assign the opportunity to

contact_id.description: Contact ID associated with the opportunity

date_won.description: Date the opportunity was won. Example: "2026-06-19"

date.description: Task date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for a dateless task.

assigned_to.description: User ID to assign the task to

is_complete.description: Whether the task is complete. Defaults to false

contact_id.description: Contact ID associated with the task

url.description: HTTPS endpoint URL for the webhook subscription. Example: "https://example.com/webhook"

items.description: Event string in the format "action.object_type", e.g. "create.lead", "update.contact", "delete.opportunity"

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify the SSL certificate of the destination URL. Defaults to true.

id.description: The ID of the lead to delete. Example: "lead_xxx"
The ID of the note activity to delete. Example: "acti_123"
The ID of the webhook subscription to delete. Example: "whsub_6un6NQjYTaFdgtIZsTDXP6"

lead_id.description: Lead ID to filter activities by. Example: "lead_xxx"

user_id.description: User ID to filter activities by. Example: "user_xxx"

date_updated__gt.description: Filter activities updated after this ISO8601 timestamp. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00"

cursor.description: Pagination offset from the previous response (maps to _skip). Omit for the first page.

_limit.description: Max number of results per page. Default 100, max 100 for activity endpoint. Example: "100"

actions.description: List contacts, optionally filtered by lead.
actions.name: list-contacts

lead_id.description: Filter contacts by lead ID. Example: "lead_xxx"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (skip value) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of contacts to return per page. Max 200.

actions.description: List Close leads with optional search query and pagination
actions.name: list-leads

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (offset) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of results per page. Max 200.

status_id.description: Filter by opportunity status ID. Example: stat_YT79kszvqlYbs5HhEYBEtr0CkZ41Ey0RqXpLaUsr1li

pipeline_id.description: Filter by pipeline ID. Example: pipe_4RR4Vuxbp8jRIcQEzEzcEJ

date_updated__gt.description: Filter by update time greater than. Example: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (offset). Omit for the first page.

lead_id.description: Lead ID to filter tasks by. Example: "lead_xxx"

assigned_to.description: User ID to filter tasks by assignee. Example: "user_xxx"

type.description: Task type to filter by. Example: "lead" or "opportunity"

view.description: Task view to filter by. Example: "inbox", "future", or "archive"

date_updated__gt.description: Filter by update time greater than ISO8601 timestamp. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Max 200.

actions.description: List all users in the organization.
actions.name: list-users

actions.description: List all configured webhooks for the organization.
actions.name: list-webhooks

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (_skip offset) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page. Omitted if there are no more pages.

url.description: Lead URL. Pass null to clear.

description.description: Lead description. Pass null to clear.

status_id.description: Valid organization lead status ID. Pass null to clear.

custom.description: Custom fields. Pass null to clear.

note.description: Plain text note content. Setting this overwrites note_html.

note_html.description: HTML note content. Takes precedence over note if both are provided.

contact_id.description: Contact ID to associate with the note. Example: "cont_WkCG7ujzTYPCoOTUcao7tRUj9TMChmWgeNXimiJT9eJ"

activity_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the activity occurred. Example: "2026-06-19T12:00:00.000000+00:00"

value.description: Value in USD dollars (not cents). Example: 50000

note_html.description: Rich-text HTML note. Pass null to clear.

contact_id.description: Contact ID. Pass null to remove association.

user_id.description: User ID. Pass null to remove assignment.

date_won.description: Date won (ISO 8601). Pass null to clear.

date_lost.description: Date lost (ISO 8601). Pass null to clear.

text.description: Task text/description. Only modifiable for lead-type tasks.

assigned_to.description: User ID to assign the task to.

date.description: Task date in ISO 8601 or date format. Example: "2026-07-01"

due_date.description: Task due date in ISO 8601 or date format. Example: "2026-07-01T00:00:00+00:00"
